perPrompt.name: car-status
perPrompt.title: Car status briefing
perPrompt.messageText: Give me a status briefing for my Polestar. Use get_car_status, then is_car_secure, then get_needs_attention, and finish with a two-line summary plus anything that needs action.

perPrompt.name: charge-plan
perPrompt.title: Cheapest charge plan
perPrompt.messageText: I want to charge my Polestar as cheaply as possible tonight. Spot prices from my tariff provider: ask me for hourly prices as {"startsAt": ISO, "price": number} pairs before planning. Call plan_cheapest_charge with these prices and present the result as a simple schedule with estimated cost.

perPrompt.name: battery-health-report
perPrompt.title: Battery health report
perPrompt.messageText: Report on my Polestar's battery health: call get_degradation_report and get_charging_sessions, summarize the implied capacity trend, and say clearly whether there is enough history to conclude anything.
